about: Traits (Decision 64, rated; Decision 128): each id, what it does, its tags - which say where it may sit - and optionally 'only', narrowing that further. An item's own traits must be allowed on the item; what it 'grants' its carrier must be allowed on a unit.

traits.description: Plays dead more readily, and is harder to see through doing it; a leader's helps its formation's downed (Decision 127).
Hard to fool: sees through foes playing dead (Decision 127).
Captures downed foes rather than finishing them (Decision 121).
A routing unit with it never surrenders (Decision 121).
A leader's: lets one downed foe go home per level, a morale blow to its side (Decision 121).
A leader's: takes a leaderless friendly group it meets after a fight into its own command (spec 30 round 3).
A leader's: brings its group into the command of a friendly group it meets after a fight (spec 30 round 3).
Its formation retreats at a march rather than a run, if its leader or every unit has it (Decision 126).
Its formation pursues at a march rather than a run, if its leader or every unit has it (Decision 126).
Its formation never waits for a unit lagging behind its place, if its leader or every unit has it (spec 30 round 3).
Its formation waits for every unit lagging behind its place, even one that has fallen far behind, if its leader or every unit has it (spec 30 round 3).
Shrugs off its first N wounds (Decision 126).
Its regeneration keeps running while it is downed (Decision 121).
Carries more before it can't move: a higher load limit per level (Decision 120).
Digs through ground of dig_difficulty up to its level (Decision 64).
Climbs a cliff of climb_difficulty up to its level at the climb pace, one level short at half (Decision 64); every unit has it at 0 (spec 30).
Swims water at least its height deep that flows up to its level at the swim pace, one level short at half (Decision 64, spec 30 round 3); every unit has it at 0.
Never climbs, whatever the cliff - a cart (spec 30).
Never swims, at any load - the opposite of the norm, a cart (spec 30 round 3).
Sees in the dark (Decision 83).
A weapon's: damages structures (Decision 47).
A weapon's: a foe it downs takes N wounds more (Decision 126).
A weapon's or a body attack's: breaks blocks of hardness up to its level - a pickaxe, not the arm that swings it; every attack has it at 0 (Decision 137).
A creature's: its own attacks, and weapons it wields, break blocks as breaker at its level; wielding a breaker weapon never grants it (Decision 137).
A creature's: its own attacks, and weapons it wields, strike as siege - an earth elemental, even thrown; wielding a siege weapon never grants it (Decision 137).
A spare unit with it carries downed friends to the rear, drops them and returns to the fight (Decision 134).
A leader's: its formation's spare units carry downed friends to the rear and return (Decision 134).
Fights while climbing without the climbing penalties; its grip still holds its limbs (Decision 135).
Fights while swimming without the swimming penalties (Decision 135).
How hard it is to dig: a burrower of at least this level gets through (Decision 64).
How hard it is to climb: a climber of at least this level gets up (Decision 64).
It is a liquid, flowing at this rate (Decision 64).
It falls and settles (Decision 64).
It lights its surroundings at this level (Decision 64).
